itineraries.title: Raleigh First Friday: Gregg Museum, NCMA Artist Talk, Artspace, Día de los Muertos at the City of Raleigh Museum, Live Music at The Davie
itineraries.theme: A free art day that ends at First Friday: NC State's Gregg Museum, a lunchtime artist talk at the NC Museum of Art, then downtown galleries, a Día de los Muertos celebration and no-cover live music
itineraries.drive_time: No highway driving. Gregg Museum is about 1.5 mi and NCMA about 4 mi (straight line) west of downtown Raleigh, roughly 10-15 min each by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). The evening is all downtown and walkable.

weather.summary: Chance Showers And Thunderstorms (patchy fog early); Mostly Clear at night

itineraries.cost_range: All events free; about $45-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Friday has a chance of showers and thunderstorms in the day (high 72°F), clearing at night (low about 51°F); sunset is about 5:15 PM. Every daytime stop is indoors. Have breakfast downtown at The Morning Times, see Bobby C. Martin's exhibition at the Gregg Museum, have lunch at Irregardless, then hear artist Nancy Baker Cahill speak at NCMA at noon. Come back downtown for Artspace First Fridays from 5 PM, dinner at Sitti, the City of Raleigh Museum's 10th annual Día de los Muertos from 6:30 PM, and Michael Parker at The Davie from 8 PM.

morning.title: A Creek in Carolina: Artworks by Bobby C. Martin
morning.location: Gregg Museum of Art & Design, 1903 Hillsborough St., Raleigh, NC 27607
morning.notes: Open 10 AM-5 PM. Solo exhibition by Muscogee (Creek) artist Bobby C. Martin. Info: https://gregg.arts.ncsu.edu/exhibitions/a-creek-in-carolina-artworks-by-bobby-c-martin/

afternoon.title: Perceiving Otherwise: Ecological Imagination and Experiential Practice in Polycrisis (artist talk)
afternoon.location: North Carolina Museum of Art, East Building SECU Auditorium, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd., Raleigh, NC 27607
afternoon.notes: Noon-1 PM. Talk by transdisciplinary artist Nancy Baker Cahill. Info: https://ncartmuseum.org/event/perceiving-otherwise-ecological-imagination-and-experiential-practice-in-polycrisis/

evening.title: Artspace First Fridays
evening.location: Artspace, 201 East Davie Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 5-10 PM. New exhibitions, a hands-on art activity, and 30+ studio artists. Info: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/artspace-first-fridays-tickets-1976774095533

evening.title: First Friday Market & Movie Night: Fantastic Mr. Fox (2009)
evening.location: Moore Square, 201 S. Blount Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 5-9 PM. Outdoor screening, food trucks, vendor market, live music and field games; bring a blanket or chair. Walk through on the way to dinner. Info: https://www.get2knowraleigh.com/event-details/first-friday-market-movie-night-fantastic-mr-fox-2009

evening.title: 10th Annual Día de los Muertos
evening.location: City of Raleigh Museum, 220 Fayetteville St., Ste. 100, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 6:30-9 PM. Music, dance, poetry, art and traditional food. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/10th-annual-dia-de-los-muertos/111406/

evening.title: First Friday Live Music at The Davie: Michael Parker
evening.location: The Davie, 444 S. Blount St., Ste. 101, Raleigh, NC 27601

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (Bread Shop multigrain, diced potatoes, house guacamole, sliced tomato, cotija)
food.notes: 10 E. Hargett Street, Raleigh NC 27601. Own menu: all items served daily 7 AM-5 PM. Avocado Toast $7.50; vegetarian by its listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: "Not Chos" (VG, GF): cashew queso, vegan chorizo, pickled onion, guacamole, pico de gallo, tortilla chips
food.vegetarian_dish: Spanakopita (VEG): spinach, feta, phyllo, green goddess
food.notes: 901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603, between the Gregg Museum and NCMA. Own menu: lunch Tue-Fri 11 AM-2:30 PM. "Not Chos" $11 (VG, GF), Spanakopita $14 (VEG). Eat at about 11:15 AM to reach NCMA by noon.

food.vegan_dish: Vegan Tasting: hummus, mouhamra, fattoush, warak anab, roasted vegetables, falafel
food.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Tasting: hummus, baba ghanouj, fattoush, cheese rolls, warak anab, falafel
food.notes: 135 S. Wilmington Street, Raleigh NC 27601, about two blocks from the City of Raleigh Museum. Own contact page: Fri-Sat 11 AM-10 PM. Own dinner menu: Vegan Tasting $19.95 (labeled vegan), Vegetarian Tasting $19.95 (labeled vegetarian).

alternatives.leg: Moore Square market and outdoor movie (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: The forecast clears by evening (mostly clear, about 51°F at night). Bring a blanket or chair and a layer.
alternatives.rain: If showers linger, stay indoors: Artspace is open until 10 PM (event c59d90b1a419), and the City of Raleigh Museum is open 6-9 PM (event b006c8d9c3a8, free).

alternatives.leg: Evening theater instead of live music
alternatives.good_weather: Michael Parker plays The Davie from 8 PM; its listing marks it as both indoor and outdoor.
alternatives.rain: Raleigh Little Theatre's Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead starts at 7:30 PM indoors, $30-$33 (event ad0f05f99efd; https://raleighlittletheatre.org/shows/rosencrantz-and-guildenstern-are-dead/). It is about 2 mi west of downtown, so skip the last part of Día de los Muertos.

practical_notes: Suggested start: breakfast at The Morning Times at 8:30 AM; Gregg Museum opens at 10 AM.
Daytime stops (Gregg Museum, Irregardless, NCMA) are west of downtown; drive between them, then return downtown by 5 PM.

Sitti's contact page lists nearby parking: the Blount Street Deck (314 Blount St; public parking restricted 7 AM-7 PM Monday-Friday), 214 S. Salisbury Street, the 313 S. Wilmington Street lot, and the McClatchy lot (123 W. Hargett St).
Artspace, Moore Square, the City of Raleigh Museum, Sitti and The Davie are all downtown; park once and walk.
All events are free. NCMA talk details: https://ncartmuseum.org/event/perceiving-otherwise-ecological-imagination-and-experiential-practice-in-polycrisis/

itineraries.title: Durham Saturday: Farmers' Market, Festival of Fabulous Mums at Duke Gardens, Pauli Murray House Tour, Golden Belt Winter Market, "The Minutes" at Hayti
itineraries.theme: Durham history and gardens: the Saturday farmers' market, Duke Gardens' mum festival with a free floral-design demo, a guided tour of Pauli Murray's childhood home, an artists' market, and a Tracy Letts dark comedy at the Hayti Heritage Center
itineraries.drive_time: About 21 mi straight line from downtown Raleigh to downtown Durham, roughly 30-35 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). All stops are within about 3 mi of each other.
itineraries.cost_range: Market, gardens, floral demo and art market free; Pauli Murray tour $10; The Minutes $11-$21; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny Saturday (high 65°F, low about 42°F; sunset about 5:15 PM). Eat breakfast at Elmo's Diner, shop the Durham Farmers' Market, then spend late morning at Duke Gardens for A Festival of Fabulous Mums and the free 11 AM floral design demo. Lunch at Luna, take the 1 PM guided tour of Pauli Murray's childhood home, and catch the last hour of the Golden Belt Artists Winter Market. Have dinner at Viceroy, then see Bulldog Ensemble Theater's "The Minutes" at the Hayti Heritage Center at 7:30 PM.

morning.title: Durham Farmers' Market (Saturday)
morning.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC 27701
morning.notes: 8 AM-noon. Local farmers and food producers. Info: https://www.durhamfarmersmarket.com/

morning.title: A Festival of Fabulous Mums
morning.location: Sarah P. Duke Gardens, 420 Anderson Street, Durham, NC 27708
morning.notes: 10 AM-4 PM. Exhibition mums outdoors at the Japanese Garden in the Culberson Asiatic Arboretum and indoors at the Doris Duke Center. Info: https://gardens.duke.edu/event/a-festival-of-fabulous-mums-5/

morning.title: Festival of Fabulous Mums: Basic Floral Design with Patty Stimmel
morning.location: Pelham-Cullen Classroom, Barnes Welcome Center, Duke Gardens, 420 Anderson Street, Durham, NC 27705
morning.notes: 11 AM-noon. Free demonstration by a retired floral designer. Info: https://gardens.duke.edu/event/festival-of-fabulous-mums-basic-floral-design-with-patty-stimell/

afternoon.title: Guided Tours of Pauli Murray's Childhood Home
afternoon.location: The Pauli Murray Center for History and Social Justice, 906 Carroll Street, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 1-2:15 PM. Tickets: https://www.ticketsource.com/pauli-murray-center-for-history-and-social-justice/ (the ticket site blocked automated checks; open it in a browser). Info: https://www.discoverdurham.com/events/guided-tours-of-pauli-murrays-childhood-home/

afternoon.title: Golden Belt Artists Winter Market 2026
afternoon.location: Golden Belt Arts, 800 Taylor Street, Mill No. 1, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 11 AM-3 PM; arrive by 2:30 for the last half hour. Local artists' holiday market. Info: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/golden-belt-artists-winter-market-2026-tickets-2001063358372

evening.title: "The Minutes," presented by Bulldog Ensemble Theater
evening.location: Hayti Heritage Center, St. Joseph's Performance Hall, 804 Old Fayetteville St, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: 7:30-9 PM. Tracy Letts' dark comedy about a town council meeting. Tickets/info: https://www.bulldogdurham.org/minutes

food.vegetarian_dish: Breakfast "Soyrrito" (scrambled eggs, soy sausage, sautéed onions, red sauce, melted cheese, with frijoles and a side)
food.notes: 776 9th Street, Durham NC 27705. Own site: Saturday-Sunday 7 AM-3:30 PM. Own menu: Breakfast 'Soyrrito' $9.50 and Veggie Breakfast Burrito $8.90 (eggs, tomatoes, green peppers, onions, red sauce, cheese); vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower (V): breaded and fried cauliflower with chili-lime glaze
food.notes: 112 W Main St, Durham NC 27701. Own hours page: open seven days, 11 AM-9 PM. Own menu (V = vegetarian, V+ = vegan): Chili Braised Jack Fruit $16 (GF, V+), Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower $11 (V). Leave by 12:45 PM for the 1 PM tour.

food.vegan_dish: Gobi Sukka (GFr, V): crispy battered cauliflower sautéed with onions, peppers and curry leaves
food.vegetarian_dish: Tandoori Mushrooms (Veg): mushrooms marinated in the chef's spices
food.notes: 335 West Main Street, Durham NC 27701. Own site: Friday-Saturday 5-10:30 PM. Own dinner menu (image; legend: V = vegan, Veg = vegetarian): Gobi Sukka $12 (GFr, V), Tandoori Mushrooms $16 (Veg), Achari Paneer $22 (Veg). Eat at 5:30 PM to reach Hayti by 7:15.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and about 65°F; mornings are cool (low about 42°F), so bring a layer for the 8:45 AM market.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If plans change, the mum display is also inside the Doris Duke Center, and the floral design demo is indoors (event 24f7df1dc163).

alternatives.leg: History walk instead of the art market
alternatives.good_weather: Hymns for Salted Bones, a free theatrical walking tour of six homes along the historic Fayetteville Street corridor in Hayti, runs 2-3:30 PM from the Stanford L. Warren Library, 1201 Fayetteville St (event cd756d212f2c; registration: https://preservedurham.app.neoncrm.com/nx/portal/neonevents/events?path=%2Fportal%2Fevents%2F54061). It overlaps the end of the 1 PM Pauli Murray tour.
alternatives.rain: Stay with the indoor Golden Belt Artists Winter Market (event 0de2d7e93edd).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:30 AM for breakfast at Elmo's (776 9th St) at about 8 AM.
Durham Farmers' Market is at Durham Central Park, 501 Foster St.
Pauli Murray tour tickets ($10): https://www.ticketsource.com/pauli-murray-center-for-history-and-social-justice/
The Minutes tickets ($11-$21): https://www.bulldogdurham.org/minutes
Luna (112 W Main St) and Viceroy (335 W Main St) are both on W Main St downtown.
Drive back to Raleigh after the show takes roughly 30-35 min (estimate).

itineraries.title: Hillsborough Saturday: Guided Walking Tour, Harvest Festival at the Burwell School, Fall Nature Fun Day on the Eno, Studio Tour Preview, Redbud Gala
itineraries.theme: Small-town history and fall outdoors: a guided walk through one of North Carolina's oldest towns, bluegrass on the Burwell School porch, a family nature day on the Eno River, an artists' preview show, and an optional literary fundraiser gala
itineraries.drive_time: About 33 mi straight line from downtown Raleigh to downtown Hillsborough, roughly 40-45 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). Confluence Natural Area is about 5 mi north of downtown Hillsborough; the gala venue on Dairyland Rd is about 8 mi south.
itineraries.cost_range: Walking tour $10; Harvest Festival free-$20; nature day and preview show free; Redbud gala $25 and up (optional); about $40-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny Saturday (high 65°F, low about 42°F; sunset about 5:15 PM). Have breakfast at The Village Diner, take the 10:30 AM guided walking tour from the Visitors Center, and lunch at Antonia's on Churton St. Spend early afternoon at the Hillsborough Harvest Festival (bluegrass, food trucks, makers), then drive to the Eno River Association's Fall Nature Fun Day at Confluence Natural Area. Stop at the Orange County Artists Guild studio-tour preview before 6 PM, eat at Nomad, or go on to the Redbud Writing Project gala at 6:30 PM.

morning.title: Hillsborough Guided Walking Tours
morning.location: Hillsborough Visitors Center, 150 East King Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: 10:30 AM-12:30 PM. Guided walk through historic downtown Hillsborough. Tickets: https://www.zeffy.com/ticketing/3277bebb-5a4c-48ec-9a1e-0c4e287138b5 (the ticket page blocked automated checks; open it in a browser). afternoon.notes: Noon-4 PM. Bluegrass on the front porch, food trucks, local artists and makers, beer and wine; proceeds benefit two local nonprofits. Listings disagree on admission (free, free-$20, $20); check https://www.etix.com/ticket/p/78629127/hillsborough-harvest-festival-hillsborough-hillsborough-community-media

afternoon.notes: Noon-4 PM. Free family-friendly hands-on day with the Eno River Association. Info: https://www.enoriver.org/events-on-the-eno/

evening.location: Hillsborough Gallery of Arts, 121 N. Churton St., Hillsborough, NC 27278
evening.notes: Open 10 AM-6 PM. Preview of work by artists on the guild's open studio tour. Info: http://www.HillsboroughGallery.com

evening.notes: 6:30-9 PM. Fairytale-themed fundraiser; its listing says buffet dinner, open bar, silent auction and a reading by NC Poet Laureate Jaki Shelton Green. If you go, skip dinner at Nomad. Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/redbud-writing-project-presents-an-enchanted-evening-gala-fundraiser-tickets-1996252144903 Info: https://www.redbudwriting.org/2026-fundraising-gala-1

food.vegetarian_dish: Veggie Omelet (Swiss cheese, spinach, mushrooms, onions; with seasoned homefries)
food.notes: 600 W. King St., Hillsborough NC 27278. The menu PDF (dated 10-2025) lists Tuesday-Saturday 8 AM-1:30 PM; the restaurant's homepage says Tuesday-Sunday 8 AM-1:30 PM. Veggie Omelet $14; vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Grilled Vegetable Panini (grilled portobello, roasted red pepper, roasted tomato, spinach, mozzarella, pesto aioli; with a small salad)
food.notes: 101 North Churton Street, Hillsborough NC 27278, near the Visitors Center. Own site: lunch Tuesday-Saturday 11 AM-4 PM. Grilled Vegetable Panini $14.50; vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Chana Masala (marked GF/VG): chickpeas, potato curry, pickled onions, basmati rice
food.notes: 122 West King Street, Hillsborough NC 27278 (in the historic Osbunn Theater). Own site: Saturday 4-10 PM. Own menu: Chana Masala $19 (GF/VG) and Thai Cauliflower $13 (GF/VG: roasted and flash-fried cauliflower, red Thai sauce, roasted coconut, peanuts). The menu does not define 'VG'; ask whether a dish is vegan.

alternatives.leg: Walking tour and Fall Nature Fun Day (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and about 65°F. Wear walking shoes for the 2-hour tour and the trails at Confluence Natural Area.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If plans change, stay on Churton St: the Studio Tour Preview Show is indoors from 10 AM (event cb8366984e9d), and the Harvest Festival listing is at the Keckly Center (event 0f2bf266c1b7).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:45 AM for breakfast at The Village Diner (600 W. King St) at about 8:30 AM.
Harvest Festival parking is available at Mount Bright Baptist Church, 211 W. Union St (per the visithillsboroughnc.com listing).
Downtown stops (Visitors Center, Antonia's, Burwell School, Hillsborough Gallery of Arts, Nomad) are a few blocks apart along Churton and King Streets.
Walking tour tickets ($10): https://www.zeffy.com/ticketing/3277bebb-5a4c-48ec-9a1e-0c4e287138b5
Redbud gala tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/redbud-writing-project-presents-an-enchanted-evening-gala-fundraiser-tickets-1996252144903
Drive back to Raleigh takes roughly 40-45 min (estimate).

itineraries.title: Cary and Apex Saturday: Farmers Market, Old North State Storytelling Festival, Taste of China, Infinity Ballet at The Halle, Carolina Roller Derby
itineraries.theme: A family-friendly western-Wake day: the Cary farmers market, a sensory-friendly storytelling showcase, the Taste of China festival in Downtown Cary Park, a one-hour fairytale ballet in downtown Apex, and a roller derby doubleheader
itineraries.drive_time: About 8 mi straight line from downtown Raleigh to downtown Cary (roughly 20 min) and about 12 mi to downtown Apex (roughly 25 min) (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Farmers market and Taste of China free; storytelling showcase $27; ballet $12-$18; roller derby $8-$20; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny Saturday (high 65°F, low about 42°F; sunset about 5:15 PM). Have brunch at Peck & Plume, walk the Cary Farmers Market, then see the sensory-friendly showcase of the Old North State Storytelling Festival at The Cary Theater. Walk over to the Taste of China Festival in Downtown Cary Park, lunch on dosai at Udupi Cafe, and drive to Apex for Infinity Ballet's "Fairytale Fables" at The Halle at 2 PM. Finish at the Carolina Roller Derby doubleheader from 5 PM and dinner on Salem Street at The Provincial.

morning.title: Cary Farmers Market

afternoon.location: The Halle Cultural Arts Center, 237 N. Salem St., Apex, NC 27502
afternoon.notes: 2-3 PM. One-hour family dance performance in the Storybook Dance series. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/infinity-ballet%3a-%22fairytale-fables%22/108852/

evening.notes: 5-9 PM. At 5 PM the Carolina Bootleggers face Twin Valleys Roller Derby's Mountain Mayhem (per The Triangle Weekender). Listings give $8-$20 and $15-$20. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/carolina-roller-derby-fall-double-header/111866/

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (NF, V): griddled sourdough, beet root hummus, avocado, whipped ricotta, pomegranate seeds, boondi, za'atar

Avocado Toast $14 (NF, V), Peck & Plume Porridge $11 (NF, V), Chilaquiles Verdes $15 (NF, GF, V). No brunch item is labeled VG.

food.vegetarian_dish: Masala Dosai (rice crepe with potato-onion filling); Mysore Masala Dosai adds a spicy chutney layer
food.notes: 590 E Chatham St, Ste 112 & 114, Cary NC. Own menu: Masala Dosai $12.99 and Mysore Masala Dosai $13.99, both labeled vegetarian; MLA Pesarattu Dosa $17.99 is Saturday-Sunday only. No item is labeled vegan; ask about ghee and dairy. The page says it opens at 11:30 AM but does not list hours by day. Eat by about 12:45 PM to reach Apex by 2.

No vegan dish verified. Eat after the first bout (about 7 PM) or before the derby at 4:30 PM.

alternatives.leg: Farmers market and Taste of China (outdoor, Downtown Cary Park)

Peck & Plume, the farmers market, The Cary Theater and Downtown Cary Park are all in downtown Cary; park once and walk. Udupi Cafe is on E Chatham St east of downtown; drive.
Storytelling tickets ($27): https://www.etix.com/ticket/p/92179497/2026-old-north-state-story-telling-festivalsensory-friendly-showcase-cary-the-cary-theater?partner_id=100

Roller derby tickets: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/carolina-roller-derby-fall-double-header
Drive back to Raleigh from Apex takes roughly 25 min (estimate).

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill and Carrboro Sunday: Goat Yoga, Ackland Art Museum Tour, Sweater Weather Bazaar, Jennifer Curtis Solo Violin, UpClose Chamber Music
itineraries.theme: An arts-and-makers Sunday: farm goat yoga, a free 30-minute Ackland collection tour, a 30-plus-maker outdoor bazaar on the Carrboro Town Commons, a solo violin concert at The ArtsCenter, and a free chamber music evening on Franklin Street
itineraries.drive_time: About 25 mi straight line from downtown Raleigh to downtown Chapel Hill, roughly 35-40 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). 1870 Farm is about 3 mi south of downtown Chapel Hill; Carrboro is about 1 mi west.
itineraries.cost_range: Goat yoga $25; Ackland tour, bazaar and chamber concert free; Jennifer Curtis $30-$35; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny Sunday (high 64°F; sunset about 5:15 PM). Eat breakfast at Carolina Coffee Shop, then drive to 1870 Farm for 10 AM goat yoga. Have brunch at Kipos, take the free 1 PM Ackland tour, and shop the Sweater Weather Bazaar in Carrboro. Hear violinist Jennifer Curtis at The ArtsCenter at 3 PM, have dinner at Haw River Tap & Table, and end with The Durham Fellows at CURRENT Studio at 7:30 PM.

food.notes: 300 East Main St, Unit C, Carrboro NC 27510, near The ArtsCenter. Own site: kitchen Sunday noon-9 PM. Own menu: Nashville Hot Tofu Sandwich $11 (v) and Salsa Brava Tots $9 (v). The menu marks items (v) without a legend; the pretzel with cheese is also (v), so read it as vegetarian. No vegan dish verified. Its Second Sunday Bluegrass Jam runs 3-5 PM (event 6d568e058436).

alternatives.leg: Goat yoga at 1870 Farm and the Sweater Weather Bazaar (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and about 64°F; cool in the morning, so bring a layer for 10 AM yoga.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If plans change, go indoors: the Carrboro CD & Record Show runs noon-6 PM at the Carrboro Century Center, free (event 57fd80d8ae7f), and Morehead Planetarium shows Supermassive Black Holes at 3 PM (event 694ad744f5b5; price not listed).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:45 AM for breakfast at Carolina Coffee Shop at about 8:30 AM, then drive about 3 mi south to 1870 Farm by 10 AM.
Goat yoga booking ($25): https://www.1870farm.com/goat-yoga
Ackland tours are limited to 20 people; arrive a few minutes early.
The Carrboro stops (Town Commons, The ArtsCenter, Haw River Tap & Table) are within walking distance of each other.
Jennifer Curtis tickets ($30-$35): https://artscenterlive.org/november-8th-jennifer-curtis-solo/
Drive back to Raleigh takes roughly 35-40 min (estimate).

itineraries.title: Veterans Day in Wake Forest and Raleigh: Rolesville Ceremony, Calvin Jones House Tour, Historic Oakwood Cemetery Field of Honor, John R. Miller at Kings
itineraries.theme: A Veterans Day observance with local history: the Blue Star Memorial ceremony in Rolesville, a free tour of the Calvin Jones House in Wake Forest, the Field of Honor dedication at Historic Oakwood Cemetery, then dinner and a show in downtown Raleigh
itineraries.drive_time: About 13 mi straight line from downtown Raleigh to Rolesville and 16 mi to downtown Wake Forest, roughly 25-30 min each by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service). Rolesville to Wake Forest is about 5 mi. Oakwood Cemetery is about 1 mi from downtown Raleigh.
itineraries.cost_range: Rolesville ceremony and Calvin Jones House tour free; Oakwood ceremony price not listed; John R. Miller $20 advance / $22 day of; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A mostly sunny Veterans Day (high 68°F; sunset about 5:15 PM). Have breakfast at Brigs in Wake Forest, attend the Veterans Day ceremony at the Blue Star Memorial in front of Rolesville Town Hall (call to attention 10:45 AM), then tour the Calvin Jones House at the Wake Forest Historical Museum. Have lunch at Village Deli & Grill, drive to Raleigh for the 2 PM Honor Ceremony and Field of Honor dedication at Historic Oakwood Cemetery, then have dinner at Irregardless and see John R. Miller with Lou Hazel at Kings at 8 PM.

morning.title: Veterans Day Celebration (Blue Star Memorial)
morning.location: Rolesville Town Hall (Blue Star Memorial), 502 Southtown Circle, Rolesville, NC 27571
morning.notes: Ceremony 11 AM-noon; call to attention 10:45 AM. Hosted by the Community Gardeners of Rolesville, the Rolesville Veterans Group and the Joel Fund; the rain location is the Community Center (514 Southtown Circle, event fbacf9fa6b48). Info: https://www.rolesvillenc.gov/parks-recreation/special-events/veterans-day

afternoon.title: Tours of the Calvin Jones House

afternoon.notes: Tours 10:30 AM-12:30 PM; arrive by noon. Register: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/tours-of-the-calvin-jones-house-tickets-1990564958375

afternoon.title: Veterans Day: Honor Ceremony and Dedication of the Field of Honor

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny and about 68°F; both are short outdoor ceremonies.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. The Rolesville listing names the Community Center (514 Southtown Circle) as its rain location (event fbacf9fa6b48). For an indoor afternoon instead of Oakwood, the Gregg Museum at NC State is open 10 AM-5 PM, free (event e3b5e22c72a8).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 8:45 AM for breakfast at Brigs (12338 Wake Union Church Rd) at about 9:15 AM, then drive to Rolesville by 10:40 AM.
Calvin Jones House tour registration: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/tours-of-the-calvin-jones-house-tickets-1990564958375
Allow roughly 30 min (estimate) from Wake Forest to Historic Oakwood Cemetery for the 2 PM ceremony.
Kings is downtown at 14 W. Martin St; Irregardless is on W Morgan St just west of downtown.
John R. Miller tickets: https://tickets.venuepilot.com/e/john-r-miller-2026-11-11-kings-raleigh-f0bc16
